settings.title: System Settings
settings.systemInstructionsDesc: Highest-priority instructions applied to all users' AI responses (Supervisor / Admin)
settings.systemInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Always reply in English. Keep answers concise, under 300 words.
settings.userCommonInstructionsDesc: Common constraints/guidelines defined by Supervisor for all users. Takes priority over personal instructions (Supervisor / Admin)
settings.userCommonInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Users cannot perform delete operations directly. Guide them to contact an administrator.
settings.userInstructionsDesc: Personal instructions applied only to your AI responses. Lower priority than system and common instructions.
settings.userInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. Always include code examples. Use bullet points for lists.
settings.pageDesc: Manage system settings such as LLM providers and test connections.

agent.uploadHint: Click to select ZIP files (multiple allowed)
agent.deleteMessage:
Delete agent '{name}'?
Its registration and API routes will be removed. This cannot be undone.
agent.pageDesc: Manage built-in and ADDON agents — toggle activation and configure MCP settings.
agent.exportNameHint: Must not duplicate an existing agent · starts with a letter (PascalCase recommended)
agent.exportProvenance: Base agent provenance is automatically added to the exported meta.json description
agent.exportBundleHint: Dockerfile · docker-compose.yml · .env.standalone are auto-generated with the given ports

users.title: User Management
users.pageDesc: Add or remove platform users and manage their roles and status.
users.confirmReset: Reset this user's password? A temporary password will be issued.
users.deactivateMessage:
Deactivate account '{name}'?
Deactivated users cannot log in.
users.resetMessage:
Reset the password for '{name}'?
A temporary password will be issued and shown only once.
users.deleteMessage:
Delete user '{name}'?
The account and its access will be removed. This cannot be undone.

mcp.extraArgsAuthHint: Auth args: api_key:<key> — validates the client x-api-key header, auth_user:<user id> — issues a service-account JWT. Falls back to MCP_API_KEY / MCP_AUTH_USER in .env
mcp.deleteMessage:
Delete MCP config for '{name}'?
The MCP proxy will stop and external clients will be disconnected.
